motivation_disclosure: This is a second test of F3 with new scalar constructions and a different TOTAL axis, motivated by the physical mechanism that shared fatigue may lower total goals. It is not repeated significance searching on the same hypothesis.
prior_result_boundary: Task A's FAIL remains valid only for capped home-away rest-day difference on the DELTA axis.

data.future_confirmation: kickoff_utc > 2026-09-03T23:59:59.999999Z; requires a separate future preregistration after accumulation
data.source_rule: Use only the fixed local Task A target, PIT xG, and factor snapshot artifacts; no acquisition or source substitution.
data.source_path_and_sha_reporting: The boundary-first loader records paths and SHA-256 after it exists; paths are not selected using results.

loader.inspection_output: field names, counts, exclusions, and assertion counts only; never row contents

candidate_model.form: One standardized scalar X and one fitted coefficient beta; no intercept, interaction, feature engineering, or hyperparameter search.
candidate_model.axis: candidate_total = baseline_total + beta*X; delta unchanged; reconstruct lambdas as (total+delta)/2 and (total-delta)/2 with current total and lambda clamps.
candidate_model.standardization: Mean and population standard deviation fit only on the four fitting folds.
candidate_model.coefficient_fit: Minimize multiclass log-loss on fitting folds by deterministic golden-section search over beta in [-2,2] for 96 iterations; report a boundary solution and do not widen or refit.
candidate_model.evaluation: TRAIN-2024-only five deterministic fixture-cluster OOF folds assigned by int(sha256(fixture_id)[:8],16)%5. Fit on four folds and score the held-out fold; pool each fixture's single OOF prediction.
candidate_model.near_constant: population_std == 0 on any required fitting cohort yields FAIL_NEAR_CONSTANT

baseline.optional_inputs: home_elo=None, away_elo=None, home_squad_value_eur=None, away_squad_value_eur=None, lineup adjustments zero and disabled
baseline.probability_model: Exact independent Poisson score matrix normalized on goals 0..10, then aggregated to HOME/DRAW/AWAY

inference.resampling: Sample TRAIN pooled OOF fixture IDs with replacement and retain all three class components together.
inference.one_sided_lower_95: 5th percentile of bootstrap mean paired Brier improvements
inference.pass_rule: OOF Brier improvement > 0, one-sided 95% lower bound > 0, and p < 0.025. All other outcomes FAIL. PASS means screen-in for future confirmation only.

required: OOF Brier improvement, one-sided 95% lower bound, p-value, and corrected-alpha result
log-loss, ECE, reliability, and resolution baseline and candidate
actual value distributions with special emphasis on the min-rest lower tail
usable fixture and fixture-cluster counts and all exclusions
side-by-side comparison with Task A rest-difference DELTA result
explicit statement that VALIDATION 2025 and HOLDOUT 2026 were not consumed

power_note: If short-rest observations are sparse, report the test as underpowered for the shared-fatigue mechanism; do not alter the construction.
known_limitation: Fixture-level bootstrap does not cluster repeated fixtures from the same team-season; intervals may be slightly narrow.
stopping_rule: Run once, report once, stop. Do not change family, boundary, construction, axis, model, optimizer, metrics, bootstrap, missing policy, or threshold after seeing results.
